annotation: Myb family transcription factor APL; Transcription factor required for phloem identity. Has a dual role both in promoting phloem differentiation and in repressing xylem differentiation during vascular development. Regulates the expression of the transcription factor NAC045 (AC A4VCM0). May activate the transcription of specific genes involved in phosphate uptake or assimilation. Promotes flowering through transcriptional activation of both FT and its transport machinery component, FTIP1.
Trihelix transcription factor GT-2; Probable transcription factor that binds specific DNA sequence.
Protein BIG GRAIN 1-like A; Involved in auxin transport. Regulator of the auxin signaling pathway; Belongs to the BIG GRAIN 1 (BG1) plant protein family.

Nuclear transcription factor Y subunit B-8; Component of the NF-Y/HAP transcription factor complex. The NF-Y complex stimulates the transcription of various genes by recognizing and binding to a CCAAT motif in promoters.

Serine/threonine-protein phosphatase 2A 65 kDa regulatory subunit A beta isoform; The A subunit of protein phosphatase 2A serves as a scaffolding molecule to coordinate the assembly of the catalytic subunit and a variable regulatory B subunit. Involved during developmental process such as seedling and floral developments. Seems to act as a negative regulator of PP2A catalytic activity.
